# Final Review Proposal
**Producer:** agent:codex/gpt-5.4

## Summary

Reviewed the diff and the touched files, including the new reproduction baseline coverage and algae integration tests, and ran the targeted test suites. I found one robustness issue: the berried-window assertion relies on `TankSnapshot.recent_events`, which only retains the last 20 events.

## Amendments

1. crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_baseline_scenarios.rs:935-938 should not use `snap.recent_events` to decide whether the run ever emitted `EventKind::EggFailure`. `TankSnapshot::from_state` truncates `recent_events` to the last 20 entries at crates/tank_core/src/types/snapshot.rs:273-274, so a day with enough later events can evict the egg-failure record before the daily snapshot is taken and make this test fail spuriously. Check the full event log (`run.engine().full_state().event_log`) or add a harness helper that searches the unbounded log instead.
   Rationale: This is a robustness gap in the new regression test: it can report a false failure even when egg-failure events were emitted, especially as more systems add events over time.
